test.name: TestRealCodexCLIReadOnlyWindowsSandbox
test.gateway: current source checkout Proxy via httptest

shell.working_directory: isolated temporary directory containing the fixture marker file

official_runtime_initialization.scope: Official unelevated backend standard initialization is allowed; no custom setup was executed.
official_runtime_initialization.nul_device: The official read-only capability path calls allow_null_device, which attempts SetSecurityInfo on the NUL kernel object's DACL. This is not a manual ACL change by the test.
official_runtime_initialization.desktop: Official backend may prepare its own private desktop runtime object, depending on its runtime options.

limits: Real official CLI and local shell execution were verified; the upstream model was a deterministic fixture, not a live model.
This confirms the read-only/never/unelevated combination can read the working-directory marker on this machine; it does not assert every model-generated command will succeed.
Remaining live-model marker failures should inspect command_execution.command, exit_code, aggregated_output and the working directory without relaxing the acceptance assertions.
The test does not claim to have audited kernel object ACL changes or exhaustively verified all filesystem sandbox restrictions.
